absent: Layout and lifetime of the pseudo lock region object and meaning of its processor, geometry, buffer, completion flag and wait queue members.
Numeric value of the prefetcher disable mask and full semantics of the misc feature control register.
Contracts and failure modes of kernel counter creation, local reads, counter index lookup and release.
Definitions and field meanings of the level two and level three residency trace records.
Resource, domain and control value structures, default control computation and per domain update helpers.
Complete CPU model enumeration and boot processor descriptor layout.
Enclave, page and address binding structures, page permission encoding and reference counting rules beyond what open and release show.
Input output control command set, virtual memory operation callbacks and notifier operation callbacks.
Hardware error code meanings for the SVN leaf and the bound on entropy retry loops.
Synchronization guarantees for page array iteration and for generic address allocation helpers.

findings.text: Two architecture hooks measure pseudo lock cache residency for a supplied region object and always report completion through a flag plus wait queue wakeup before returning success, even when the host CPU model is unsupported or counters fail, in which case observed deltas stay zero and a trace record still emits.

The shared residency helper guarantees that any acquired counters are released, that the four output tallies are always populated with zero on early failure, that sampling is validated with a local read while interrupts are blocked, and that prefetcher control is saved before sampling and restored afterwards.
A tally record holds four unsigned sixty four bit values capturing hit and miss snapshots taken immediately before and after the scan.
Default counter descriptors request raw kernel only pinned sampling that begins enabled and whose record length matches the descriptor structure.
Level two residency is defined only for two Goldmont variants and pairs retired load operation event D1 hex with miss mask ten hex and hit mask two hex.

Level three residency is defined only for Broadwell server parts and uses longest latency cache event two E hex with reference mask four F hex and miss mask four one hex, with references later converted to hits by subtracting misses bounded by references.

Residency sampling runs with interrupts blocked and prefetchers forced off, relies on ordering fences to serialize counter reads and to bound speculation during the scan, and must restore the saved prefetcher control value and reenable interrupts on every path that passed validation.
Tracing for this feature is anchored under a subsystem named resctrl with a header guard and include redirection pointing at the local pseudo lock trace definition.
Three static branch keys track overall enablement plus independent monitor and allocation enablement, all starting in the false state.

The per CPU synchronization hook optionally installs supplied default class and monitor identifiers into per CPU state and then reuses the scheduler entry path for the current task rather than writing the underlying register directly.
An invalid monitor configuration index is represented by the maximum unsigned integer value.

Total bandwidth events map to configuration slot zero and local events to slot one, with any other identifier treated as invalid and reported once. Reads return only architecturally valid bits from a base register plus slot, while writes store the caller supplied value to the same location.

Cache quality configuration requires the caller to hold CPUs against hotplug, rejects levels other than two and three, builds a temporary mask containing either every member of each control domain or a single representative depending on per CPU configurability, and then synchronously applies the requested boolean on all selected CPUs before freeing the mask.

Code data prioritization enablement validates capability, attempts a quality configuration update and only then records the enabled flag, while disablement clears hardware state first when previously enabled and always leaves the flag cleared.

Resetting all controls requires hotplug protection, restores every class entry in every control domain of the supplied resource to its default value in memory, and then requests a synchronous per domain hardware refresh executed on an arbitrary member CPU across the full class range starting at zero.
A scattered feature descriptor packs a sixteen bit feature index, register selector and bit position bytes, plus thirty two bit leaf and subleaf selectors.

The static scattered table associates each feature with register, bit, leaf and subleaf across low leaves six and seven, leaves F, ten and twelve, and extended leaves in the eight hundred million range, ending with an all zero terminator entry.
Three globals hold reserved bit masks for enclave attributes, extended features and miscellaneous selection, with the extended mask initially blocking all but the two lowest bits.

Opening an enclave first acquires global usage, allocates and initializes reference counting, page index, mutex, versioned address lists, address lock and sleepable read copy update domain, attaches the object to the file, and releases global usage if initialization fails.
Global usage is guarded by a dedicated SVN mutex. The first opener refreshes the SVN under that mutex and increments, while release merely decrements under the same mutex.

SVN refresh is a no operation when the update capability is absent, otherwise warns if called with active users, retries the hardware update on entropy shortage up to a bounded loop count, treats already current as success without action, maps persistent entropy shortage to a retryable error, and maps any other failure to an input output error after a one time warning.
The SVN update assumes no enclave pages are in use and must only run on the transition from zero to one user. Invoking it with live users risks unexpected hardware errors.
A warning helper reports a named leaf failure once with decimal and hexadecimal codes, and the SVN leaf is invoked through a single input register convention.

Release drains the address tracking list one entry at a time under spin protection using safe removal, synchronizes the read copy update domain and unregisters the memory notifier before freeing each entry and dropping its reference, then drops the file reference.

Mapping validates requested permissions against per page maxima, ensures the address space is tracked, installs dedicated virtual memory operations, records the enclave pointer, and marks the area as PFN mapped, nonexpandable, nondumpable and input output.

Permission validation rejects mappings outside an initialized enclave range and any task with read implies exec personality, then scans the page index under combined mutex and index lock comparing allowed bits, periodically dropping both locks to schedule.

Address space tracking requires the caller to hold the address write lock, skips already tracked spaces found under sleepable read copy update protection, otherwise allocates, references the enclave, registers a notifier before publishing under spinlock with an ordering barrier and version increment.
Unmapped area selection rejects private mappings, honors caller fixed addresses verbatim, and delegates all other cases to the generic allocator.
The compatibility ioctl entry forwards directly to the native handler with unchanged arguments.
Log output for this file is prefixed with the module name followed by a separator.
